name: arena
doc:
Arenas (DESIGN.md "Арены", runtime/ABI.md 3.6): objects allocated with
a.New<T>() and slices with a.Alloc<T>(n) live in the arena and are all
released by a.Free() (or when the last copy of the Arena is gone). Their
retain/release are no-ops; pointers into a freed arena are invalid (not
checked). Strings and slices made by ordinary code are never arena
allocated; a.String(s) copies a string into the arena.

members.name: New
members.doc: A zeroed T in the arena.
members.summary: A zeroed T in the arena.

members.name: Alloc
members.doc:
A slice of n zeroed T in the arena (appending beyond n copies it to
the ordinary heap, as for any full slice).
members.summary: A slice of n zeroed T in the arena (appending beyond n copies it to the ordinary heap, as for any full slice).

members.name: String
members.doc: A copy of s in the arena.
members.summary: A copy of s in the arena.

members.name: Free
members.doc: Releases everything allocated so far; the arena stays usable.
members.summary: Releases everything allocated so far; the arena stays usable.
